canonical_project: NEXTDC S4 Data Centre, Horsley Park
notes: NSW Planning Portal SSD-63741210 for construction and operation of a data centre in Fairfield City with 250 MW operational capacity (six data centre buildings); determined/approved 2025-12-24. Telco News reports Multiplex has started construction at 16 Johnston Crescent, Horsley Park (two four-storey buildings, 30,743 sqm, phase one of the campus). DCD reports NEXTDC's Sydney footprint incl. S4 in Horsley Park and a planned ~550 MW campus in Sydney. Capacity basis: operational capacity per SSD.
